# Parse the songs to archive from file content
content = file_data['content']
archive_songs = []
for line in content.split('\n'):
    line = line.strip()
    if line.startswith('- '):
        song_info = line[2:]
        # Format: "Title by Artist"
        if ' by ' in song_info:
            title, artist = song_info.rsplit(' by ', 1)
            archive_songs.append((title.strip(), artist.strip()))
print(archive_songs)

steps.code:
# Define the songs to archive and the set of song IDs in playlists
songs_to_archive = [
    ("The Intangible Essence of You", "Seraphina Dawn"),
    ("The Paradox of Our Love", "Oceanic Odyssey"),
    ("Love's Last Lonely Mile", "Velvet Echo"),
    ("Caught in a Storm of Emotions", "Ethan Wallace"),
    ("When Dreams Begin to Crumble", "Oceanic Odyssey"),
    ("Gone Astray", "Aria Sterling"),
    ("Love's Aftermath", "Mia Sullivan"),
    ("Journey to the Celestial Realm", "Dylan Stone"),
    ("In the Chambers of My Mind", "Jasper Skye"),
    ("Lost in the Echoes of Time", "Ethan Wallace"),
    ("Wandering the Streets Alone", "Felix Blackwood"),
    ("The Illusion of Forever", "Liam Palmer"),
    ("Nostalgia's Hold", "Marigold Muse"),
    ("Symphony of the Twilight Forest", "Aria Sterling"),
    ("Crimson Skies of Longing", "Phoenix Rivers"),
    ("A Broken Heart's Lament", "Lucas Diaz"),
    ("Weeping Sky", "Luna Starlight"),
    ("Fading Like a Distant Star", "Hazel Winter")
]

# We have the set of all song IDs from playlists (from previous step)
playlist_song_ids = {2,7,10,17,23,29,41,46,58,65,75,80,88,89,90,91,96,99,100,104,106,110,114,116,117,118,120,128,130,148,153,160,167,171,185,188,199,201,202,203,207,208,210,212,215,216,219,223,238,246,268,271,277,278,291,300,312}

# We'll search for each song and find the song ID that matches exactly and is in the playlist set
found_song_ids = []
for title, artist in songs_to_archive:
    query = f"{title} {artist}"
    # Search with page_limit=20 to get enough results
    results = apis.spotify.search_songs(query=query, page_limit=20)
    # results is a list of songs
    # Find the one that matches title and artist exactly (case-insensitive)
    matched = None
    for song in results:
        if song['title'].lower() == title.lower():
            # Check if any artist matches
            for art in song['artists']:
                if art['name'].lower() == artist.lower():
                    matched = song
                    break
            if matched:
                break
    if matched and matched['song_id'] in playlist_song_ids:
        found_song_ids.append(matched['song_id'])
        print(f"Found: {title} by {artist} -> song_id {matched['song_id']}")
    else:
        print(f"Not found in playlists: {title} by {artist}")

print(f"\nTotal songs to archive found in playlists: {len(found_song_ids)}")
print(found_song_ids)
